post.text:
This isn’t a movie. This isn’t a dance.

This photo shows young men in Gaza forming a human shield to protect a Palestinian girl from Israeli snipers they would rather die than let her be shot. https://t.co/FdzhYlumVf
post.author_description: Echoing silenced truths. Geopolitics and unheard stories the world dares to overlook.

description.description: A group of five young people, including one woman wearing a red hijab and a keffiyeh scarf, are running through a field while holding hands. The woman is in the center, flanked by four men. They are moving across an open field with dry stalks and greenery in the background.
